notes.title: 'Trick & Treat' bonus story is LIVE
notes.content:
Thanks to all of the effort, passion, and love of our team, we could deliver the biggest update since 2019, are introducing a new bonus story and a couple of quality of life improvements! We hope you feel all the love we put in and it gives you a spark of magic this Halloween :lugamebot:

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/96d1ba40-e2b7-489d-bc55-568d7bab58de/desxswl-da59e21d-633e-441a-a9de-b13b29657c99.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..cFmuddeWPxwF7gEDIM25hpIXAp2dom_H12KDZcvpfcY[/img]
'Trick & Treat' is a 1-hour bonus story about how you and Tifa come home from Trick or Treating to make a shocking discovery! Tucked into Tifa bag of treats is a mysterious retro games cartridge with no label! Sounds like the setup to a creepypasta! :lugamegamechild:

Enjoy this atmospheric spooky mini-story with the LuGame girls (sans Alex), the perfect way to spice up your Halloween night!

Features:
[list]
[*]A mystery to solve inspired by internet legends
[*]Approx 1hrs gameplay (depending on user's intuition)
[*]Many new music tracks
[*]Cute bonus artwork
[*]Totally free and ready to play right now! :lugamecontroller:
[/list]

[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/96d1ba40-e2b7-489d-bc55-568d7bab58de/desxt19-16c36478-afd8-4c18-b106-53a8e1fbaf83.gif?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..5FbpUjLkI2pUeBB3IOdbArGRDHB6fMScgNJ5PtRoOPY[/img]
In addition to the new bonus event, we have included a number of quality of life features, most notably are unique ending credits for all five stories, illustrated by the talented [url=https://twitter.com/MoozuaMary]Moozua[/url], programmed by [url=https://twitter.com/Raseruuuuu]Raseruuu[/url] and a couple of behind-the-scenes updates to the engine courtesy of [url=https://twitter.com/renpytom]RenpyTom[/url].

A big shout-out to all the talented people who made this update possible:
[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/MoozuaMary]Moozua[/url] for illustrating all of the sugary-sweet end credit chibis
[*][url=https://twitter.com/Raseruuuuu]Raseruuu[/url] for coding the bonus story and the end credits
[*]Niku for coming back to write the spooky scenes (owl. can't handle spooky!)
[*][url=https://twitter.com/dojipan]Dojipan[/url] for illustrating Tifa's jaw-dropping succubi outfit!
[*]Felufelu for creating the bonus story pixel art
[*]Cj'Pit for the absolutely stunning bonus soundtrack
[*][url=https://twitter.com/renpytom]RenpyTom [/url]for updating Ren'Py to version 7.4
[*]and YOU, for making all this possible!
[/list]

Have fun, enjoy and play nice! :lugamejoystick:
Kind regards, [url=https://twitter.com/urban_meadows]H. Hochkins/UrbanM[/url] (Creator)

notes.title: 'I Dated A Robot!' new route update is LIVE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/a8542385b69bd47cc515f6609cccb66b739deebb.png[/img]
It's been a wild month, with Trading Cards, Backgrounds and Emoticons all enabled and now, thanks to the herculean efforts of our amazing team, the bonus route 'I Dated A Robot!' has been delivered and is now available for you to download and play for free! ːlugamecontrollerː

As our way of saying thank you for all your wonderful love, support and feedback, this massive update to include the 'I Dated A Robot!' route is completely free and features all of the following: ːlugamegamechildː
[list]
[*] 25,000 words of additional story in a new K-T route!
[*] 2 New Achievements
[*] 5 New Outfits
[*] 2 New Songs
[*] 3 New CGs
[*] 5 New Locations
[*] 3 New WEBM animations
[*] Bonus Content Access Panel
[*] CG Gallery Feature
[*] Visual Companion Feature
[*] All for free
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/4e119cc775e04ea69742c79f1429cc992c31c9a9.png[/img]

To play the new route, simply access the new 'Bonus Content' panel, select 'I Dated A Robot!' from the menu and click 'Play Now'. Since this is a massive overhaul build it's possible you may experience bugs, please direct any bug reports to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/812840/discussions/]Steam Discussions forums[/url]! Thank you! ːlugamejoystickː

And finally, please take a moment to congratulate the team on their heroic efforts!
[list]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/jelpiparade]owl.[/url] for her incredible writing talent, without which LuGame would not be possible.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/SpewingMews]SpewingMews [/url]for her gorgeous artwork that breaths life into your adorable waifus!
[*][url=https://twitter.com/WhiteCharism]WhiteCharisma[/url] who went above and beyond to provide our top-notch 3D scenes.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/dssansVN]ds-sans[/url] who completely overhauled our GUI.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/tyberalyx]Alyx[/url] who delivered his two bonus songs before his computer gave in.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/renpytom]RenpyTom[/url] for making this all possible with Ren'Py.
[*][url=https://twitter.com/MoozuaMary]Moozua[/url] who provides all the illustrations drawn by K-T.
[*]And YOU, for making all this possible!
[/list]

Have fun, enjoy and play nice! ːlugamebotː

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Avaliable!
notes.content:
[b]Trading Cards are here![/b]

Thanks to your incredible support and love for the game, we're very proud to reveal that LuGame now has Trading Cards! To grab yours, simply log into Steam and check your inventory, if you don't have any - you'll need to play LuGame for at least 1 hour to earn them (which shouldn't be difficult since we're about to drop a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/812840/announcements/detail/1656688677573574264]huge free update[/url]!

Combining all six trading cards levels up your LuGame badge, each time you do, you'll get an exclusive item drop, such as emoticons and profile backgrounds for your Steam profile!
Here's the full feature list:
[list]
[*] 6 cute and collectible trading cards in a set!
[*] 9 versatile and adorable emoticons to collect! ːlugamebotːːlugamecardsːːlugamecontrollerːːlugamegamechildːːlugameheadphonesːːlugameheartːːlugamejoystickːːlugamephoneːːlugamestarː
[*] 5 illustrious backgrounds, which one will you get?
[/list]
Check out this K-T profile background, isn't she adorable?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/88d21c9cd05da72a92fe11abbad40e4fe25cd16f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/bda4ee7bc7d858a7765239f9ee275a30dfb7b85f.png[/img]
Fun fact! You can convert gems into a new card pack to complete your badges!
Log into Steam, access your inventory and click on your Gems Pile.
Select LuGame and then 'Make Pack' to instantly receive 3 new cards!
Alternatively, you can also just click this link to take a shortcut:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com//tradingcards/boostercreator/#812840]https://steamcommunity.com//tradingcards/boostercreator/#812840
[/url]

Looking for trades? Visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/812840/tradingforum/]LuGame Trading Forum[/url]!
We couldn't do it without your support - Thank you so much, we really hope you enjoy trading, collecting and showing off your new loot the Steam profiles and forums! ːlugamebotː

H. Hochkins
Director, Urban Meadows Publishing

notes.title: Free Content Update In November!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/5a9735fe6288f284355a90f1257544a1427d1d78.png[/img]Every review has helped us improve the LuGame experience and thanks to your feedback we have a huge announcement - A free content update packed full of new features!

Our team and [b]ds-sans[/b] (developer of the highly anticipated Visual Novel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/734900/Chemically_Bonded/]Chemically Bonded[/url]) to develop new tools and features for Ren'Py and combine it with an enormous package for update v1.07 that will feature the following:[list]
[*] 20,000 words of additional story
[*] 5 New Outfits
[*] 2 New Songs
[*] 3 New CGs
[*] 5 New Locations
[*] Bonus Content Access Panel
[*] CG Gallery Feature
[*] All for [b]free[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34790953/9ce4a4f35385c0cbe6655b20f749bdf0a759cd4b.png[/img]
It's such a big update, that v1.07 will receive [b]its own trailer[/b], viewable on the Steam Store Page.
So make sure you've ticked [b]"Following"[/b] on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/812840/LuGame_Lunchtime_Games_Club]LuGame Steam store page[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/LuGameVN]follow LuGame on Twitter[/url] to be informed when the final release date for v1.07 is revealed! 

Thanks again for all your love and support!
We couldn't do it without you! ːlugamebotː

H. Hochkins
Director, Urban Meadows Publishing

notes.title: Missing Mac Executable 1.06.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790953/82eb3c12792cccdc90bb80d84a3becbd152af07d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790953/fefbf8397fc0c688ab2c9bf98b37eeac76ea7d33.png[/img][/url]
Fixed a Steampipe bug, Mac users can now access their game.
If you are a Mac user and you're experiencing a 'missing executable file' error, then your files need to be updated! Simply perform the following:
[list]
[*] Exit Steam completely
[*] Make sure you have an internet connection
[*] Open Steam and sign in
[*] Click 'Play LuGame' from your Steam library
[*] The game should automatically update
[*] Enjoy your waifus
[/list]
If you have any issues please leave a comment or open a discussion thread. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: v1.06 Released!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790953/82eb3c12792cccdc90bb80d84a3becbd152af07d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34790953/fefbf8397fc0c688ab2c9bf98b37eeac76ea7d33.png[/img][/url]
The eagerly-anticipated 1.06 update is here!
We listened to your feedback and made a few improvements!
[list]
[*] Hundreds of spelling and grammar mistakes corrected
[*] Enhanced UI
[*] Separated PC/OSX Depots to reduce filesize
[*] Removed Imaginary Gingerbread Cake
[*] Added Imaginary Cupcakes
[/list]
Massive thank you to [b]Dream[/b], who went through the entire script and cataloged hundreds of spelling mistake, grammar error, and continuity issues.

[b]ds-sans[/b] provided the new custom UI, with assets designed by [b]Chobittsu[/b].

And special thanks to you! We couldn't do it without you!:machiko:

[i]We'll have a very special announcement in the coming weeks, make sure to hit 'Follow' and/or Follow our [url=https://twitter.com/LuGameVN]Twitter[/url] for updates![/i]
